maria: Quick question — re: quant profiles, do we have a formal policy on 'shelf life' for profiles (how long we consider them valid before re-calibration)?
kevin: short answer: no, we don't. we treat them as semi-permanent today. we should define windows.
oliver: ops note: runtime only consumes profile id + blob. no semantics about age or model binding. that worries me.
maria: yeah — thinking we should require metadata: calibrated_at, model_sha (or model_tag), stability_window_days, degrade_threshold_pct.
kevin: agree. also need migration path: shadow+canary + schema versioning.
anya: QA perspective: we need a compact eval set per profile to quickly surface quality drift. propose 50-200 prompts depending on model size.
maria: sketch for profile meta:```
profile_meta:
  model_sha: "abc123"
  calibrated_at: "2026-02-01T12:00:00Z"
  stability_window_days: 30
  degrade_threshold_pct: 0.8
  schema_v: 1
```
kevin: runtime acceptance rules idea: 1) parse schema_v (backwards compat), 2) if model_sha != served.model_sha -> tag request and warn, 3) if now - calibrated_at > stability_window_days -> mark stale and prefer safer lane.
oliver: +1 but we need a graceful fallback for older profiles: runtime should accept v1 but emit telemetry and a single flag so routing can make decisions.
maria: also want a "shelf_life_expired" signal surfaced to Console and Optimize so sales/CS can see at a glance.
kevin: proposed runtime pseudocode:
```
if profile.schema_v not in supported_versions:
  reject_profile() # or convert if possible
elif profile.model_sha != served.model_sha:
  tag = "profile_mismatch"
elif now - profile.calibrated_at > profile.stability_window_days:
  route = "high_fidelity"
else:
  route = "lowbit_allowed"
```
maria: can we also add profile_retire_reason enum? values: ["model_update", "quality_regression", "manual"]
anya: QA will keep a watchlist of active profiles and run nightly shadow evals. we'll flag any degrade above degrade_threshold_pct.
oliver: operationally we should add a feature flag to flip stricter behavior (reject old profiles) so we can rollout gradually.
deploy-bot: deploy:precision-validator v0.9.1 deployed to staging — 2026-03-21 09:12Z :rocket:
kevin: i'll open an RFC-followup PR with schema draft + runtime acceptance tests + telemetry events.
maria: action items: @kevin PR w/ schema + tests, @anya create eval set and watchlist, @oliver add runtime shim and feature flag, @maria monitor Console signals. revisit in 3 days.
oliver: ack
